# Hi, I'm Oziel Ramos Torrez 👋🐧 ### Full Stack Developer · Software Engineering Student **React · TypeScript · NestJS · Flutter · Python · AI · Cloud** *Automating things… occasionally penguins 🐧*
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-ozioziel-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/ozioziel) [![LinkedIn](https://img.shields.io/badge/LinkedIn-Oziel%20Ramos%20Torrez-0A66C2?style=for-the-badge&logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/oziel-rodman-ramos-torrez-98b914403) [![Credly](https://img.shields.io/badge/Credly-Google%20Cloud%20Credential-FF6B00?style=for-the-badge&logo=credly&logoColor=white)](https://www.credly.com/badges/2077fe64-ee88-488a-ba3a-6f04930aabbb/public_url) [![Email](https://img.shields.io/badge/Email-roziel147%40gmail.com-EA4335?style=for-the-badge&logo=gmail&logoColor=white)](mailto:roziel147@gmail.com)
--- ## About me I'm a **Software Engineering student at Universidad Católica Boliviana "San Pablo" in La Paz, Bolivia**, focused on full-stack development, mobile applications, AI-powered systems and cloud deployment. I enjoy taking ideas from prototype to working product: designing interfaces, building APIs, connecting databases, integrating AI services, deploying applications and adapting software to real-world constraints. Some of my projects started in hackathons and later evolved into **professional consulting work or enterprise-oriented implementations**. - Focused on **Full Stack Development** - Interested in **AI, RAG, automation and intelligent interfaces** - Building mobile applications with **Flutter** - Experience with **Linux, VPS and Oracle Cloud** - Comfortable with relational databases and backend APIs - Interested in **IoT, Arduino and software–hardware integration** - I enjoy algorithms, graphs and problem solving - Based in **La Paz, Bolivia** - Penguins are somehow involved 🐧 --- ## Tech Stack ![Arduino](https://img.shields.io/badge/Arduino-00878F?style=flat-square&logo=arduino&logoColor=white) - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (**RAG**) - LLM API integration - Prompt / context orchestration - Computer vision - Hand tracking with MediaPipe - REST APIs - WebSockets - Authentication with JWT / cookies - Deployment on Linux VPS environments --- # Featured Projects ## HyperFlow / Asistente Maxi — InnovaHack 2026 An AI assistant originally developed as a hackathon prototype for the **Hipermaxi supplier portal** and later redesigned toward a more enterprise-friendly architecture. The project evolved from a prototype integrated directly into a simulated portal into an **embeddable widget**, reducing coupling with the host application and making adoption easier. **Highlights** - Conversational assistant with text and voice interaction - AI-powered contextual assistance - RAG-based knowledge retrieval - Embeddable widget architecture - Frontend/backend separation - Enterprise-oriented integration strategy - Collaborative development **Prototype** https://github.com/ozioziel/PortalHipermaxi-Frontend **Current team repository** https://github.com/daniel69zz/hipermaxi_innova **Recognition** 🥇 **1st Place — InnovaHack Santa Cruz 2026** --- ## MAPIA A mobile/full-stack project focused on geolocation, mapping and location-based services. **Technologies and concepts** - Flutter - NestJS - PostgreSQL / PostGIS - Supabase - Google Maps - REST APIs - Authentication - Cloud deployment https://github.com/ozioziel/mapia --- ## 🐧 PenguinGraph An interactive graph editor built to explore **graph theory and algorithms visually**. Users can create and manipulate vertices and edges, work with directed and undirected graphs, assign weights, inspect adjacency matrices and analyze critical paths. **Highlights** - Custom graph editor built with React - SVG-based graph rendering - Directed and undirected edges - Weighted graphs - Adjacency matrix generation - JSON import / export - Critical path visualization - Drag & drop interaction **Stack** `React · JavaScript · Vite · SVG · Algorithms` Repository: https://github.com/ozioziel/PenguinGraph Demo: https://grafos-algoritmos.vercel.app/ --- ## ControlHand A hand-gesture-controlled robotic car project that combines **computer vision, Flutter, Python and Arduino**. The system detects hand gestures through a camera, maps them to movement commands and uses them to control a physical vehicle. **Highlights** - Hand tracking with MediaPipe - Computer vision with OpenCV - Python + Flask backend - Flutter application - Gesture-to-command mapping - Arduino-based physical vehicle - Bluetooth-oriented control architecture **Stack** `Flutter · Dart · Python · Flask · OpenCV · MediaPipe · Arduino` https://github.com/Holorololo/ControlHand --- ## HuellitasFind IoT A pet-oriented web project that integrates a web application with **Arduino, GPS and real-time communication**. **Highlights** - GPS tracking - Arduino integration - Serial communication - WebSockets - Real-time position updates - Vue frontend - Node.js backend **Stack** `Vue · Vite · Node.js · WebSockets · Arduino · GPS` https://github.com/ozioziel/HuellitasFind-TecnologiasWeb --- ## GeTa A collaborative social platform oriented toward university students. I worked primarily on the **frontend**, integrating the application with a backend developed separately by another team member. **Highlights** - Authentication flow - User profiles - Feed - Career-based communities - Messaging - Notifications - API integration - Collaborative Git/GitHub workflow **Stack** `React · TypeScript · Vite · REST APIs` https://github.com/ozioziel/GeTa-Frontend --- ## HuellitasFind — Collaborative Project A separate collaborative project developed under the `dan-tats-ozi` organization. The project includes frontend, backend and hardware-oriented components. https://github.com/dan-tats-ozi/HuellitasFind --- # Professional Experience ## Independent Software Consultant — Ipas Bolivia **April 2026** Contracted as part of a consulting team to formalize, improve and deliver a functional MVP originally created during an innovation hackathon. The work involved transforming a validated prototype into a more complete deliverable, including technical organization, documentation, functional demonstration and final product delivery. > The source code and project materials are private due to contractual confidentiality and intellectual-property obligations. --- # Awards & Hackathons ### 🥇 1st Place — InnovaHack Santa Cruz 2026 Developed an AI assistant for the Hipermaxi supplier portal as part of team **NexoLab**. The project later continued evolving toward an enterprise-oriented implementation. --- ### 🥈 2nd Place — Ipas Bolivia Digital Innovation Hackathon 2026 Developed a digital solution with social impact. The prototype was later selected for a **paid professional consulting process** to formalize, improve and deliver the MVP. --- ### 🥈 2nd Place — FUNCTEC 2024 Universidad Católica Boliviana "San Pablo". --- ### Build with AI La Paz 2026 — GDG La Paz Participant in the Google Developer Groups hackathon focused on building AI-powered solutions. --- ### Fundación CONSTRUIR — Access to Justice Hackathon 2026 Participant in a technology and innovation hackathon focused on digital solutions for access to justice. --- # Education ### Universidad Católica Boliviana "San Pablo" **B.Sc. / Engineering Degree in Systems Engineering** La Paz, Bolivia **2024 — Present** Areas of interest include: - Software Engineering - Web Development - Algorithms and Data Structures - Databases - Cloud Computing - Artificial Intelligence - Mobile Development - Systems Analysis and Design --- # Certifications ### Google Cloud Data Analytics Certificate Issued by **Google Cloud** [![Credly](https://img.shields.io/badge/View%20Credential-Credly-FF6B00?style=flat-square&logo=credly&logoColor=white)](https://www.credly.com/badges/2077fe64-ee88-488a-ba3a-6f04930aabbb/public_url) --- ### Cisco Networking Academy — Networking Basics Fundamentals of computer networks, connectivity and networking concepts. --- ### Cisco Networking Academy — Introduction to Cybersecurity Foundational cybersecurity concepts, threats, vulnerabilities and security practices. --- ### Microsoft 365 Copilot Skilling Campaign 2026 Training focused on the use of generative AI across Microsoft 365 productivity tools. --- # Languages **Spanish** — Native **English** — Upper-intermediate, conversational and technical proficiency I can communicate about software development, explain technical decisions and participate in technical conversations in English. --- # Currently Working On - Improving **HyperFlow** for a safer and easier enterprise integration - Cleaning and documenting my open-source / portfolio projects - Strengthening my **React + Node.js / NestJS** full-stack skills - Building and deploying applications on Linux / cloud infrastructure - Learning more about backend architecture, cloud systems and AI integration --- # What I'm Looking For I'm currently open to opportunities as a: - **Junior Full Stack Developer** - **Junior Software Developer** - **Frontend Developer** - **Backend Developer** - **Software Engineering Intern / Trainee** I'm especially interested in teams where I can contribute to real products, learn from experienced developers and continue improving as an engineer. --- # Contact - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/oziel-rodman-ramos-torrez-98b914403 - GitHub: https://github.com/ozioziel - Email: roziel147@gmail.com - Google Cloud credential: https://www.credly.com/badges/2077fe64-ee88-488a-ba3a-6f04930aabbb/public_url ---

repos.description: PenguinGraph es una aplicacion web interactiva, su principal objetivo es proporcionar una herramienta que permite al usuarios construir grafos personalizados añadiendo vertices y añadiendo aristas sobre un lienzo, ademas de poder eliminar los elementos, seleccionarlos individualmente y colocarles tanto nombre como valor a cada uno.
